messages:
lydia-cs: Heads up — ACME opened an escalation via Zendesk. They report that after yesterday's rollout the assistant started inserting "ACME" or product mentions into unrelated answers. Ticket ACME-1847. Can someone triage?

olivia-support: Sharing redacted customer examples they attached. They say same prompt used earlier gave neutral replies; now brand mentions are appearing.

Customer example 1:
User prompt: "How do I reset my password on a generic SaaS app?"
Model response (now): "To reset your password, go to Settings → Security. If you use ACME SSO we recommend enabling two-factor with ACME Auth..."

Customer example 2:
User prompt: "What's the best way to explain feature flags to a PM?"
Model response (now): "Feature flags let you toggle features. At ACME we've used flags to ship X..."

lydia-cs: They included prompt logs and convo IDs. They believe it started after 2026-03-12 rollout (deploy-id: deploy-2026-03-12-3c9f). @deploy-bot any notes?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout deploy-2026-03-12-3c9f -> model-registry:v1.14.0 -> 2026-03-12T09:12:00Z. No automatic rollback.

mike-ml: Looping in ML/Eng. To repro we need 1) full request payloads/system messages (redact PII), 2) model_id + config (temp, max_tokens, stops), and 3) request_id headers if hosted. Also token-level trace if available.

olivia-support: Asked customer; they returned three request ids: req_zz13, req_zz14, req_zz15 and attached logs zip. They said they called "redwood-chat-2-small" via hosted API.

jordan-eng: Paste minimal prompt template?

olivia-support: Minimal prompt template (redacted):
"system: You are a helpful assistant.\nuser: {{user_question}}"

jordan-eng: Noted. Also checking whether this is model hallucination vs post-processing. I'll check the branding/augmentation pipeline.

jordan-eng: FYI we shipped a small branding augmentation in v1.14.0 intended only for customers who opted into "Assistant Branding". Could be a gating bug.

sara-product: That should never run for customers who didn't opt in. @mike-ml @jordan-eng what telemetry shows for flag evaluation?

mike-ml: Requesting exact headers for one request id to trace feature-flag evaluation and generation trace. That will tell if text was appended or generated.

olivia-support: Sent header dump for req_zz14 to ticket. Their headers show X-Customer-Account: acme-inc and Feature-Flags: none (per customer). They insist they didn't opt in.

jordan-eng: Running query on flag eval for req_zz14...

jordan-eng: Found root cause — the rollout targeting used a buggy regex that matched any account containing "ac". ACME matched. Branding module mistakenly applied. Opening rollback + patch.

jordan-eng: PR: github.com/redwood/branding/PR-642. Rolling back augmentation for non-opted customers; patching targeting rule.

deploy-bot: Config rollback applied: config-rollback-2026-03-15-08:42 -> targeting-rule reverted -> propagation ~30s.

mike-ml: After rollback we need a minimal repro. Olivia, can you ask the customer to run this curl and send a new request id? Include response body and headers.

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-2-small","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"How do I reset my password on a generic SaaS app?"}],"temperature":0.2,"max_tokens":200}'

olivia-support: Sent to customer. Also asked them to confirm no downstream post-processing.

ACME (via zendesk-bot): Ran the curl after rollback. New request id: req_zz19. Response no longer mentions ACME. Thanks.

sara-product: Need postmortem and customer note. @jordan-eng please include timeline, root cause (regex targeting bug), fix (rollback + PR), and mitigations (unit tests, explicit lists, canary checks).

jordan-eng: Drafting postmortem and attaching to ticket. Adding CI test for segmentation.

mike-ml: I'll add monitoring for brand tokens in outputs for non-opted accounts; create anomaly alert if spike.

lydia-cs: I'll send the customer-facing note once legal approves. Keeping ticket open until postmortem published. :white_check_mark:

zendesk-bot: Ticket ACME-1847 updated: status -> resolved by lydia-cs.

olivia-support: Customer thanked us and will re-open if they see the issue again. Closing on our side after PM review.
